answer: Because of that, capturing the pool requires several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. The vertex cap is applied at the anchor settlement and visible in the lantern breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. A single identity may take at most 22% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
